question.text: A circular coil is placed near a current carrying conductor, both lying on the plane of the paper. The current is flowing through the conductor in such a way that the induced current in the loop is clockwise as shown in the figure. The current in the wire is,

solution.text:
Hint : If current is increasing in upward direction, so magnetic field is increasing in out of plane in order to oppose it induced current will be in clockwise direction
Similarly if current is decreasing in downward direction, so magnetic field is decreasing into the plane in order to support it induced current will be in clockwise direction.
